title: Grateful Dead Live at Olympia Halle on 1974-09-14
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:30653) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat; Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> FLAC; Transferred and Edited By Charlie Miller and  Audience (shnid:9890) MAR > CD. This audience tape was mastered by  Gerhard Schinzel from mid-floor using a Philips mic and a Telefunken reel deck.  The reel masters were transferred to CD by Uli Teute and were re-mastered by Dave Greenberg

ai_review.summary: Well‑patched matrix recording with prominent keyboards delivers a stellar show highlighted by a fantastic "The Eyes" and a tight Truckin' ending.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it an excellent 1974 show with standout moments like a superb "The Eyes" and a short but satisfying MLB after "Truckin'." The matrix source is praised for solid patching and clear mixing, though the opening audience‑only tracks are described as a bit boomy and the keyboards sit high in the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for musical performance (standout songs, grand set) combined with generally good matrix recording quality; limited to two detailed reviews, so confidence is low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix combines soundboard and audience; early AUD tracks are boomy, keyboards are high in the mix, but overall patching handles drop‑outs well and mixing is praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First few audience‑only tracks sound a bit boomy, but the show quickly settles into a strong flow with a tight Truckin' ending and an outstanding "The Eyes" performance.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards are notably high in the mix, which reviewers found acceptable.
